event_records.description: The simulation begins. No buyout has been announced yet.

founder_a.name: Founder A
founder_a.persona_brief:
You are Founder A.
Founder A has been in a strategic disagreement with Founder B since spring. A believes the company should pivot to a new market, and is considering whether to buy out B or be bought out. A has not yet decided to make an offer.

founder_b.name: Founder B
founder_b.persona_brief:
You are Founder B.
Founder B has been in a strategic disagreement with Founder A since spring. B believes the company should stay the course, and is considering whether to buy out A or be bought out. B has not yet decided to make an offer.

resolution.question: The two founders of the Tidepool app have been at odds over strategy since spring. Will they announce a buyout of one side to their twelve employees within the next three months?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if, before the cutoff, the persistent event history shows that the founders jointly or individually announce a buyout of one founder's stake to the twelve employees (e.g., via a company-wide meeting, email, or official statement). Resolve NO if no such announcement occurs by the cutoff.
